summary: Hudbay Minerals furnished a 6-K attaching a Canadian Material Change Report (the US equivalent of a Form 8-K current report on material developments) concerning the October 21, 2026 final investment decision with 30% joint venture partner Mitsubishi to build Copper World in Arizona. The 70/30 JV targets first production in H2 2029, with a base case 15-year mine life using state and local permits only and an extension case of 37 years requiring federal permits. Initial growth capex is about $2,070 million (100% basis, net of equipment financing), funded by Mitsubishi's $600 million JV equity, Wheaton's $230 million stream deposit, roughly $650 million project debt and pro-rata equity. This is an organic project sanction, not a special situation; watch funding, permits and capex execution.
